additional_info.subject: 0407864 - ID0407864-DC/Si-D/UK[170002824] - DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 CRM:00315002386
additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good morning.
Leaving here a summary of the steps taken so far, starting from the beginning:
XD10
Measured between 7B and 5B = 1.1kOhm → okay
Measured between 8D and 6D = 0.937kOhm → not okay
Between 7A and B5 = 2.5kOhm → not okay
Between 8C and 6D = 1.6kOhm → not okay
We plugged out the XD10 terminal block and put back in → now we measured 1kOhm from the PT1 and PT2 to 5B and 7B → 1kOhm = okay
XD16
1.039kOhm both between 7B-5B and 8D-6D
PT2 to 6D = 80kOhm → not okay
PT1 to 5B → not ok
We bypassed the XD16 directly to KF14 and we measured 1kOhm with 5B and 8D to PT1 and PT2 respectively.
Charger is still with error of temperature sensor, the readings are not reaching the KF14 correctly.
As you showed me your video, it seems that the plug is coming to green and white in seconds, so it must be a bad contact or the KF14 is faulty. Only the Minus part of the temperature sensors are not reading correctly, so from PT2 to 8D of XD10 and XD16.
Next steps is to order a new KF14 and go to site to retest this scenario.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: 0407864 - ID0407864-DC/Si-D/UK[170002824] - DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 CRM:00315002386
additional_info.body:
Hello guys, good morning.
After yesterday's site visit we tested replacing the KF14 and the error was still persisting.
As such we measured the PT1/PT2 from both plugs and the results were:
DC2
PT1 = 104 Ohm
XD16:7B to XD16:5B = 104 Ohm
PT2 = 324 Ohm
XD16:8D to XD16:6D = 325 Ohm
DC1
XD10:7B to XD10:5B = 233 Ohm
XD10:8D to XD10:6D = 31.6 Ohm
Just to be 100% sure there is nothing wrong with the Multimeter we measured the BT3 and got 1.1kOhm → no problem with multimeter
After this we tried measuring XD16 and XD10:
XD16:7B to XD16:5B = 1.063 kOhm
XD16:8D to XD16:6D = 172 Ohm
XD10:7B to XD10:5B = 237.5 Ohm
XD10:8D to XD10:6D = 33.8 Ohm
If the problem was not with the KF14 and the small parts (connectors/wirings → very unlikely), we checked for any signs of issues with the plug itself and we found that the cable was filled with water. (Video attached)
As such, we proceed to replace 1 CCS to confirm if this was indeed the problem and after the replacement it was working properly. Then we replaced the 2nd plug and it was also working.
Also, we left the new KF14 on the charger as you deemed unworthy to put back the old one. To be clear, since we didn't test the old one, it won't be elegible for warranty for now. Nevertheless you get to keep a spare KF14 in case you face any other issue related to the StateMonitor.
Thank you very much for your time and dedication. Always a pleasure working with you guys. See you on the next ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
